title: Sound Logos
description: Commercials, YouTube intros, loading screens. Everything we interact with has a sound logo tied to it. This project was an exercise in tailoring composition to a specific audience and understanding what drives emotional response. Three logos were created, each using different scales, instrumentation, and sample manipulation.

audio.label: Fantasy/Children
audio.desc: Whimsical and jovial. Mallet instruments, swung rhythms, and a major key. Think kid's toy brand.

audio.label: Lifestyle
audio.desc: Calm and soothing. Warm strings and extended chords that breathe without overwhelming. Think spa or wellness product.

audio.label: Horror
audio.desc: Footsteps, screams, a chainsaw. Built mostly from samples to tell a quick story. The chainsaw was originally a sheep's bleat and the scream at the end was a hawk's cry. Think horror film studio.
